text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the scavenger hunt has begun! The 
first one dashing through is—!
UWOOOOORYAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Don't chase me—! The ticket belongs to 
Turbo!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No way! This belongs to Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawawa... Calm down! Please don't 
fight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CHOMP!!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah!? I-It bit meee!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"'A dark-haired Umamusume from another 
dorm'... That's Windy-chan's prompt!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Therefore! The ticket is miiine!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mgggh, there are tons of others around, 
you know!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is an "energetic senior," so 
Turbo's taking her! When I called out, she 
was the one who raised her hand!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, when they yelled, "Found the 
cheerful upperclassman!", it just made me 
so happy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, for me, when you say Ticket, you 
think black hair, and when you say black 
hair, you think Ticket! We're in the same 
class, so you were the first person who 
came to mind~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, whaaat!? Really!? I'm happy... I'm 
sooooo happy!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Guuuh, I wanna go with both of them~!!

text_block_list.name: Turbo & Windy
text_block_list.text: That's it--!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all! That's easy! We just have 
to cross the finish line together!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's gooo! Turbo and the gang 
are number one, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe that was an option...! 
Alright, leave it to meeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!? Is that... actually 
allowed...!?

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Goooooal!!!
